# Documentation guidance

Use [docs/index.md](../../docs/index.md) to find the canonical document and
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution policy. Preserve
authority labels: explanatory documentation must not redefine versioned
contracts, architecture, governance, or migration evidence.

Update the nearest authoritative document when behavior, public interfaces, or
workflows change. Keep examples current and link to long-form authority rather
than copying it. Follow the repository's established Markdown style. No
AI-specific module-header, function-level documentation, or pedagogy-block
mandate applies.
